name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

summary.en: Israeli forces have launched a multi-day military operation in the occupied West Bank, expanding a lockdown, razing a neighbourhood in Hebron and carrying out home demolitions after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead and two gunmen were killed. Simultaneously an Israeli airstrike hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, captured on video, and raids in Hebron detained dozens of Palestinians. The United Nations cut food aid, leaving displaced West Bank Palestinians facing growing hunger. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker har igangsatt en fler-dagers militæroperasjon på den okkuperte Vestbredden, utvidet en nedstengning, revet et nabolag i Hebron og gjennomført husnedrivninger etter at to israelske soldater ble skutt drepte og to væpnede menn ble drept. Samtidig traff et israelsk luftangrep en bygning i Nuseirat, Gaza, fanget på video, og ransakinger i Hebron førte til at dusinvis av palestinere ble arrestert. FN kuttet matstøtten, noe som gjør at forflyttede palestinere på Vestbredden står overfor økende sult. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.

posts.text: The Israeli military said it had launched a sweeping crackdown in the West Bank city of Hebron overnight after Palestinian gunmen killed two Israeli soldiers there and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed to retaliate. Residents on Saturday said troops closed the city’s main entrances and exits.
